items.name: Polynomial.taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) : Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).leadingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (r : R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) p).natDegree = p.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (r : R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) p).degree = p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_zero
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R) : (Polynomial.taylor 0) f = f

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_taylor_natDegree
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff f.natDegree = f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : (Polynomial.taylor r) f = 0 ↔ f = 0
